title: Zechariah's First Vision: The Horses and the Myrtle Trees
description: In a night vision, the prophet Zechariah sees a man on a red horse standing among myrtle trees in a ravine, surrounded by red, reddish-brown, and white horses that have gone throughout the earth and report that all the earth is at rest. The angel of the Lord asks how long the Lord will withhold his mercy from Jerusalem after seventy years of wrath. The Lord answers with comforting words and promises to return to Jerusalem with mercy, rebuild the temple, and choose Zion once again. [ref:Zechariah 1:8-17|Zechariah 1:8-17]
